beats.text: A small highland settlement at the forest's edge. Terraced fields above, cook-fires below. PILLAHUASO, 10, sits at the edge of a fire, half-listening to his mother, INTI CHASKA (a local princess, not the same character as adult Chaska), speaking with an elder about the harvest. His older cousin/foster-brother-figure, ANTA (20s, a village warrior who has effectively raised him alongside his mother), sharpens a blade nearby.

beats.speaker: Anta
beats.text: You're staring at the fire like it owes you something.

beats.speaker: Anta
beats.text: Good. Then go find more wood before your mother notices you haven't.
brief free-roam of the village — light interactions with 2–3 NPCs, establishing the community before it's taken away. No combat.
Pillahuaso crosses the village. A dog barks — wrong pitch, wrong urgency. Torches appear on the ridge above. A horn sounds, not one of theirs.

beats.speaker: Elder
beats.text: To the terraces! Get the children to the terraces!

forced-stealth sequence. The player, as the boy, must move from cover to cover toward the designated safe point. No fight prompts exist for Pillahuaso — the UI deliberately shows no attack option, only move/hide.
Anta moves past Pillahuaso toward the fighting, shoving him toward a low stone wall.

beats.speaker: Anta
beats.text: Stay down. Stay here. I mean it.
Pillahuaso obeys — for a moment. Through gaps in the wall, we see Anta engage two raiders, holding a narrow path alone. He's good. He's also outnumbered.
A THIRD RAIDER approaches Anta's blind side. The game gives the player one prompt:
"WARN HIM" — a single button prompt, deliberately generous timing window
If the player succeeds: Anta still takes the hit — the QTE was never winnable, only the follow-through mattered. If the player fails or does nothing: same outcome, slightly faster. Either way—

He doesn't move. He wants to. His legs won't. The raiders pass within feet of him and don't see him — he is, for the first time, made invisible by his own fear, and it saves his life and costs him everything else.
Gameplay ends here — hard cut, no further interaction this mission.
